note: Every number here is out of sample: from periods the strategy was not tuned on. The last two years of data are held back and untouched. Each row names what it is measured against; for most that is the S&P 500 with dividends reinvested. Held up means ahead of its benchmark by more than luck allows across every variant tried in the library. The luck bar counts all 212 variants tried across the library, not only a row’s own, so it rises for every row as strategies are added.
